# namespace_network_configuration (Data Source)

Reads the effective workspace network routing and egress CIDR configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_network_configuration" "current" {}

output "network_id" {
  value = data.namespace_network_configuration.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `egress_cidrs` (Attributes List) List of possible source CIDR blocks used by compute instances in this workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress_cidrs))
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for the workspace network configuration in Terraform state (`network`).

<a id="nestedatt--egress_cidrs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress_cidrs`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Egress IP CIDR block (e.g. `198.51.100.0/24`).
- `kind` (String) CIDR allocation kind (`NAMESPACE_MANAGED`, `EXTERNAL_TRANSIT_PROVIDER`, `DEDICATED`, or `KIND_UNKNOWN`).
- `segment` (String) Dedicated network segment identifier, if applicable.
